259:t_1:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「...So it's finally time for our first hyperspace jump.」

259:t_1:5.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「$$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ will open a wormhole into subspace, and we'll follow $$ＷＩＬＬ$$'s navigation through it... This should be quite thrilling.」

259:t_1:6.en:
$$朔哉$$
「I wonder how far this jump will take us... If all goes well and we jump 10,000 light-years at once, that'd be awesome.」

259:t_1:7.en:
$$カシオ$$
「If you get your hopes up too high, it'll hurt that much more if it fails.」

259:t_1:8.en:
$$チコ$$
「Ugh, I hate that. Adults who can't dream are such a drag.」

259:t_1:9.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Sorry I'm such an old man.」

259:t_1:10.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The old wild horse can't hold his own against the current generation, can he, $$カシオ$$?」

259:t_1:11.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「What's this about a wild horse?」

259:t_1:12.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That was $$カシオ$$'s nickname as an active $$トップレス$$. He supposedly got it for the aggressive style that won him top score three years running.」

259:t_1:14.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So you used to be a $$トップレス$$, $$カシオ$$!」

259:t_1:15.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Yes, I was, embarrassing as it is.」

259:t_1:16.en:
$$ノノ$$
「And you had the top score three years running! That's amazing!」

259:t_1:17.en:
$$カシオ$$
「That was a long time ago.」

259:t_1:18.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You're too modest, $$カシオ$$. I hear everyone thought you were sure to take the top spot four years running, if you hadn't reached 《$$あがり$$》.」

259:t_1:21.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then $$ノノ$$ will explain for you! $$あがり$$ is sushi-bar jargon for tea!」

259:t_1:22.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's wrong! Besides, that's trade jargon, not a technical term!」

259:t_1:23.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Your comeback was right on the mark, $$ラルク$$.」

259:t_1:24.en:
$$チコ$$
「You're really at home on the boards with this sister comedy act, Princess.」

259:t_1:25.en:
$$ノノ$$
「'On the boards'... Do you mean chikuwa fishcake?」

259:t_1:26.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's wrong too! Kamaboko is the fishcake that comes on a board!」

259:t_1:29.en:
$$ラルク$$
「S-stop it...! Stop giving me those indulgent smiles!」

259:t_1:30.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Let's give in, Big Sis. From now on, we'll aim for the top as a pair of beautiful comedy sisters...」

259:t_1:31.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'm not aiming for anything of the sort!」

259:t_1:32.en:
$$チコ$$
「The Princess is completely flustered, so I'll explain for her.」

259:t_1:33.en:
$$チコ$$
「《$$あがり$$》 means losing your $$トップレス$$ powers.」

259:t_1:35.en:
$$チコ$$
「Everyone has $$トップレス$$ powers as a child, to a greater or lesser degree...」

259:t_1:36.en:
$$チコ$$
「But once you reach a certain age, you lose them. That includes every one of us in $$フラタニティ$$.」

259:t_1:38.en:
$$カシオ$$
「You either support $$フラタニティ$$ as a coach, like I do, or live an ordinary civilian life.」

259:t_1:39.en:
$$タケル$$
「A $$トップレス$$'s superpowers have a limit... And no one can avoid it...」

259:t_1:40.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's right, $$タケル$$. They're not something you can use endlessly, like your psychic powers.」

259:t_1:41.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So I'd rather you didn't pry into our powers.」

259:t_1:42.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'm sorry, $$ニコラ$$. I didn't mean it that way.」

259:t_1:44.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...Well, as you can see, $$あがり$$ is a rather sensitive issue for a $$トップレス$$.」

259:t_1:45.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You can say what you like to me, but be considerate of the other ladies.」

259:t_1:47.en:
$$タケル$$
(I've felt $$ニコラ$$'s anxiety and irritation before... They just came to the surface.)

259:t_1:48.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Honestly! You scared us, $$ニコラ$$! $$ノノ$$ and everyone else thought you were serious!」

259:t_1:49.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Ha ha ha, sorry, sorry. I guess my acting was a little too convincing.」

259:t_1:50.en:
$$葵$$
「...By the way, $$ノリコ$$... The other day, you said you'd fought at the center of the galaxy, right?」

259:t_1:52.en:
$$エイーダ$$
($$葵$$... You changed the subject so smoothly.)

259:t_1:53.en:
$$ジョニー$$
(She's growing as a person, too.)

259:t_1:54.en:
$$葵$$
「How did you get from Earth to the galactic center back then?」

259:t_1:55.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We used $$次元波動超弦励起縮退半径跳躍重力波超光速航法$$.」

259:t_1:57.en:
$$くらら$$
「S-sorry... Could you say that again?」

259:t_1:58.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's $$次元波動超弦励起縮退半径跳躍重力波超光速航法$$.」

259:t_1:59.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$次元波動超弦励起縮退半径跳躍重力波超光速航法$$...」

259:t_1:60.en:
$$チコ$$
「You really are an android...! You remembered it after hearing it once!」

259:t_1:62.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'd like to give you a science lecture to explain it in detail, but...」

259:t_1:63.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「To put it simply, it's a warp.」

259:t_1:64.en:
$$朔哉$$
「You made that way too simple!」

259:t_1:65.en:
$$葵$$
「Never mind how it works. Can't we reproduce it?」

259:t_1:66.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That would be difficult... $$ガンバスター$$ could warp short distances if it could use its full power, but...」

259:t_1:67.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$ only has one of the two degeneracy reactors it should have right now.」

259:t_1:68.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's damage from the battle before you came to our world...」

259:t_1:69.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「They're both $$バスターマシン$$s, even if they're from parallel worlds. Can't $$フラタニティ$$'s technology do something about it?」

259:t_1:70.en:
$$カシオ$$
「That's impossible. Those systems have nothing in common with ours.」

259:t_1:71.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Unfortunately, our world hasn't developed technology for voyages into deep space.」

259:t_1:72.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「The warp systems in $$ギシン星$$'s civilization can't handle ultra-long-distance warps across the galaxy, either.」

259:t_1:73.en:
$$タケル$$
「I've heard Earth and $$ギシン星$$ are about 1,000 light-years apart, but...」

259:t_1:74.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Even a jump that far takes a huge system and enormous amounts of energy. It's hardly easy.」

259:t_1:75.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So we'll have to take it one step at a time to get back to Earth...」

259:t_1:76.en:
$$朔哉$$
「There's still hope, $$ラルク$$. If we make good use of $$サイデリアル$$, we might get back to Earth in no time.」

259:t_1:77.en:
$$くらら$$
「They have all that advanced technology, and they still target Earth...」

259:t_1:78.en:
$$タケル$$
「The galactic center, where their main force is based, is home to many species hostile to humanity. They probably need $$次元力|lc$$ to fight them.」

259:t_1:79.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「According to $$ＷＩＬＬ$$'s data, $$宇宙怪獣$$, $$インベーダー#robot$$s, $$バジュラ$$ and $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ have been confirmed at the galactic center.」

259:t_1:80.en:
$$葵$$
「$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are the enemy the $$人類銀河同盟$$, where $$レド$$ came from, was fighting.」

259:t_1:81.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(There are $$宇宙怪獣$$ at the galactic center... Could it be...)

259:t_1:82.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ wanted Earth's $$次元力|lc$$. They probably meant to use it to fight those creatures as well as to rule the galaxy.」
